provenance.notes: FD-413 forward-limit-taper + aft-limit correction. Aft limit 47.0 -> 46.5 (certified A185E/F aft is +46.5; module was 0.5 in TOO PERMISSIVE AFT -> moved FORWARD = more restrictive = SAFE DIRECTION). Forward limit was a near-flat 29.0@<=2800 / 30.5@3350 on a ~5-11 in-too-forward scale -> certified taper 34.5@<=2100 / 41.9@3350 (module permitted CG up to 11.4 in more nose-heavy than certified at gross -> moved AFT = more restrictive = SAFE DIRECTION; worst forward-CG defect in this batch, same class as S3 c175). Certified forward limit is a single straight line 34.5 at <=2100 lb to 41.9 at 3350 lb; the middle breakpoint (2800, 38.6) lies on that line; app clamps below 2100 to 34.5. fuel_arm 46.0 -> 46.5 (module usable_fuel 84 = the 88 gal / 84 usable config whose two 44.0 gal tanks are at +46.5; the +48 arm belongs to the 65/61 gal configs). front_seats_arm 37.0 UNCHANGED (TCDS +36 to +50 adjustable, POH-nominal in range); rear_seats_arm 73.0 UNCHANGED (TCDS '+65 or +73', 73 is a certified option). baggage_arm 95.0 UNCHANGED + FLAG (TCDS 'reference weight and balance data' publishes no single baggage arm; verify against A185F POH Section 6 in Track B). empty_weight_arm 38.5 UNCHANGED (TCDS Empty Weight C.G. Range None; within corrected envelope [34.5, 46.5]). NOT changed this slice (drift-coupled, Track B): usable_fuel_gal 84, empty_weight 2050.
